sloka: कुर्वन्तस्तुमुलं युद्धं चरन्तः श्येनवल्लघु ।बाढं प्रयच्छन्नेच्छामि दीयतामिति भाषिणः ।। ७.१५.५ ॥
transliteration: kurvantastumulaṁ yuddhaṁ carantaḥ śyenavallaghu ।bāḍhaṁ prayacchannecchāmi dīyatāmiti bhāṣiṇaḥ ।। 7.15.5 ॥

translations.english: They engaged in a tumultuous battle, moving swiftly like hawks, giving fierce blows and speaking as if to say, "I do not wish to stop, let the fight be given!"
